title: Process Analysis Before Automation: The AI Readiness Gate (2026)

questions.question: What verdict does gate return for a low-sensitivity process with exception_coverage=0.75, no volume profile, and a measured manual baseline?
options: FAIL, because exception coverage and the missing volume profile are two failed checks
CONDITIONAL, because only the coverage threshold is missed
PASS, because the manual baseline is the most important check
FAIL, because low sensitivity is itself an automation blocker
questions.explanation: Coverage below 80% and the absent historical volume profile each add a failure. Two failed checks produce GateVerdict.FAIL even though the process is low sensitivity and has a baseline.

questions.question: How is Support ticket triage classified when coverage is 0.85, the manual baseline exists, but no historical volume profile is available?
options: PASS, because 85% coverage is enough to ignore peak-volume behavior
CONDITIONAL, because exactly one check—the volume profile—is missing
FAIL, because every missing volume profile counts as two failures
CONDITIONAL, but only after sensitivity is changed to HIGH
questions.explanation: Coverage clears 80%, sensitivity is LOW, and the baseline is present. The missing volume profile is the sole failed check, so gate returns CONDITIONAL.

questions.question: What happens to Contract clause risk scoring with 72% exception coverage and no measured manual baseline?
options: CONDITIONAL, because the high-sensitivity caveat replaces the coverage failure
PASS, because a legal process may rely on expert judgment instead of a baseline
FAIL, because low coverage and the mandatory HIGH-sensitivity baseline are both failures
PASS, because a volume profile is present and covers the missing checks
questions.explanation: Coverage below 80% adds one failure, and HIGH sensitivity with no manual baseline adds another. The two failures make the gate FAIL; the caveat about 95% coverage does not remove either failure.

questions.question: A HIGH-sensitivity process has 95% exception coverage, a volume profile, and a measured baseline. What verdict does gate return?
options: CONDITIONAL, because HIGH sensitivity always fails the base gate
FAIL, because full exception coverage is mandatory before any pilot
CONDITIONAL, because the volume profile is informational only
PASS, with a caveat recommending at least 95% coverage before the pilot
questions.explanation: All four failure checks pass: 95% exceeds the 80% threshold, volume and baseline are present, and the high-sensitivity baseline exists. Because coverage is below 100%, gate records a caveat but still returns PASS.

questions.question: What next step does recommend give the Medical referral routing profile with three failed checks?
options: Run a pre-analysis sprint before model selection and revisit the gate afterward
Proceed directly to a shadow pilot because high sensitivity guarantees human review
Add a max_tokens limit and deploy the first available classifier
Ignore the missing baseline until the pilot produces enough data
questions.explanation: GateVerdict.FAIL maps to the pre-analysis sprint recommendation. Each failed check becomes a bounded observation, instrumentation, or sample-audit task before a pilot budget is committed.

questions.question: What does recommend append when a HIGH-sensitivity profile passes or is conditional rather than failing?
options: A cost waiver that removes the exception-coverage requirement
A human-in-the-loop scope contract before pilot launch
A promise that the model can act without an approver
A request to discard the measured manual baseline
questions.explanation: For HIGH sensitivity and a non-FAIL verdict, recommend adds the Phase 14 human-in-the-loop scope-contract requirement. It does not waive the readiness checks.
